original_query: Are skills that require knowledge of and proficiency in a certain specialized field more important for top management or lower-level management?

confirmed.answer_text: Skills requiring knowledge of and proficiency in a specialized field (technical skills) are more important for lower-level management than for top management.
cited_statements: Technical Skills are associated with Lower-level Management and shown as the most important (darkest red bar).
Conceptual Skills are associated with Top Management and shown as the least important (lightest red bar).
